source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The four tasks check element lookup in popup, message-display and content-script documents, plus null for an arbitrary background identifier. The popup and message scenarios also check replacement of a previous target after another context-menu event. Although the popup setup registers onClicked, no task clicks an item or consumes that event; lookup IDs come from onShown. Keep that setup separate from direct coverage. The tests do not force timestamp collisions or prove that every ID is null in background.
title: Target-element tests exercise onShown lookups rather than menu-item clicks
